title: Open Ignition Gateway locally in a browser and view the system performance status page (sys.perf)
summary: Use the locally hosted Ignition Gateway web UI to open the system performance status page at http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf for a quick, observable check during troubleshooting/inspection.
when_to_use: When you need to verify that the locally hosted Ignition Gateway performance status page is reachable and displays the system performance (sys.perf) view for support troubleshooting.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a basis for configuration changes if the localhost URL or the sys.perf status page does not load.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the local Ignition Gateway URL in a browser and confirm the sys.perf status page loads; stop and escalate if it does not load.
access_or_tools_needed: Local network access to the Ignition Gateway host (localhost:8088 as shown in the source)

system_preconditions: Ignition Gateway must be reachable locally on the host at localhost:8088.

visual_references.description: Frame showing the Ignition Gateway UI accessed via browser and the sys.perf status path on localhost:8088 (/web/status/sys.perf).

steps.title: Open a web browser on the machine with local Ignition Gateway access
steps.purpose: Establish access to the locally hosted Ignition Gateway web UI.
steps.instruction: On a machine that has access to the local Ignition Gateway, open a web browser.
steps.expected_result: A browser session is ready to navigate to the local Ignition Gateway URL.
steps.healthy_condition: Browser is able to navigate to a localhost URL.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot reach localhost:8088 from the browser (navigation fails).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR shows: "Ignition Gateway UI" and the URL "http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf"; transcript mentions setting it up so it can be "running locally".

steps.title: Navigate to the Ignition Gateway system performance status page (sys.perf)
steps.purpose: Load the specific Ignition Gateway status page used for system performance inspection.
steps.instruction: In the browser address bar, navigate to: http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf
steps.expected_result: The browser displays the Ignition Gateway system performance status page at the /web/status/sys.perf path using localhost:8088.
steps.healthy_condition: The sys.perf status page loads successfully (page content is visible rather than an error/blank page).
steps.failure_condition: The localhost URL does not load or the sys.perf status page is unavailable.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the localhost URL does not load or the sys.perf status page is unavailable, stop and escalate (no recovery steps are provided in the source).
